(ii) खंड (3) के उप-खंड (i) म犆 परंतुक को िन瀓निलिखत से 灹ित瀡थािपत 琈कया जाएगा, नामत:— “बशत犇 琈क ऊजा榁 द楹 इंड榉शन मोटस榁-灵ी फेज 瀡榉वीरल केज जो िवदेशी 灙ेता 獧ारा अपेि楹त िविनद犇शन犘 के अनु牲प ह犘, “के िनया榁त के संदभ榁 म犆 इस आदेश के 灹ावधान लागू नह牷 ह犘गे।” (iii) खंड 5 के उप-खंड (1) म犆 मद (ग) को िन瀓निलिखत से 灹ित瀡थािपत 琈कया जाएगा, नामत:— “(ग) 琈कसी प琇रसर म犆 灹वेश एवं जांच कर सकता है तथा ऊजा榁 द楹 इंड榉शन मोटस榁-灵ी फेज 瀡榉वीरल केज के तैयार 瀡टॉक (िब灙琉 के िलए तैयार) को ज瀑त कर सकता है िजसके संबंध म犆 यह िव瀙वास 瀡थािपत हो 琈क इस आदेश के 琈कसी 灹ावधान का उ瀖लंघन 牣आ है अथवा उ榉त ऊजा榁 द楹 इंड榉शन मोटस榁-灵ी फेज 瀡榉वीरल केज तथा सहायक साम灡ी िविहत मानक के अनुसार नह牷 ह犉।” -- 1 of 2 -- 2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] (iv) खंड 9 के बाद िन瀓निलिखत खंड शािमल 琈कया जाएगा, नामत:— “10. उ瀖लं उ瀖लं उ瀖लं उ瀖लंघन करने पर दंड घन करने पर दंड घन करने पर दंड घन करने पर दंड –––– कोई भी 玐ि猴 जो इस आदेश के 灹ावधान犘 का उ瀖लंघन करेगा उसे भारतीय मानक 瀑यूरो अिधिनयम क琉 धारा 14 का उ瀖लंघन माना जाएगा तथा उसे उ猴 अिधिनयम के 灹ावधान犘 के तहत दंिडत 琈कया जाएगा।” [फा. सं. 14(85)/2011-एलईआई] शैलेन्灶 琐संह, अपर सिचव नोट नोट नोट नोट::::---- मु榐य अिधसूचना का.आ. 178(अ), 琈दनांक 18 जनवरी, 2017 के अंतग榁त भारत के राजप灴 (असाधारण) म犆 जारी क琉 गई थी। MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY (Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion) ORDER New Delhi, the 29th September, 2017 S.O. 3207(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by section 14 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act, 1986 (63 of 1986), the Central Government, after consulting the Bureau of Indian Standards, is of the opinion that it is necessary and expedient so to do in the public interest, hereby makes the following Order to amend the Energy Efficient Induction Motors–Three Phase Squirrel Cage (Quality Control) Order, 2017, namely :— 1. This Order may be called the Energy Efficient Induction Motors–Three Phase Squirrel Cage (Quality Control) Amendment Order, 2017. 2. In the Energy Efficient Induction Motors – Three Phase Squirrel Cage (Quality Control) Order, 2017, (i) in clause 1, in sub-clause (ii) for the word and figures “from 01.10.2017”, the words, letters and figures “from the 1st January, 2018” shall be substituted; (ii) in clause (3), in sub-clause (i), for the proviso, the following shall be substituted, namely:— “Provided that nothing in this Order shall apply in relation to export of Energy Efficient Induction Motors – three Phase Squirrel Cage, which may conform to any specification required by the foreign buyer.” (iii) in clause 5, in sub-clause (1) for item (c), the following shall be substituted, namely:— “(c) enter and search any premises and seize Energy Efficient Induction Motors – three Phase Squirrel Cage in finish stock condition (ready for sale) in respect of which it has reason to believe that a contravention of any provision of this Order has been committed or the said Energy Efficient Induction Motors – three Phase Squirrel Cage and accessories are not of the specified standard.”; (iv) after clause 9, the following clause shall be inserted, namely:— “10. Penalty for Contravention - Any person who contravenes the provisions of this order shall be deemed to have violated the provisions section 14 of the Bureau of Indian Standards Act and shall be punishable in accordance with the provisions of the said Act.”. [F. No. 14(85)/2011-LEI] SHAILENDRA SINGH, Addl. Secy. Note : The principal notification was issued in the Gazette of India (Extraordinary) vide number S.O. 178(E), dated the 18th January, 2017.
